description: Cases for the elapsed-duration format pattern used by Text Transform in the runner and editor simulator. HH is the hour component after whole days, so durations spanning a day should include D when that distinction matters. Inputs are rounded to the nearest millisecond before formatting.

cases.reason: A duration longer than a day carries whole days and a zero-to-twenty-three hour component.
Padded date-style tokens preserve leading zeroes including milliseconds.
Every supported source unit reaches the same elapsed components.
Fractional source units are retained to millisecond precision.
Values are rounded to the nearest millisecond before formatting.
Quoted literal text is kept while unquoted letters are format tokens.
Date-only tokens must not silently become literal duration text.
Quoted text must have a closing quote.
A formatter without a pattern cannot produce a predictable display.
